title: Annex 71 production-adapter thermal energy-path audit

numerical_tolerances.synthetic_energy_path_closure_w: less than or equal to 1e-9 W
numerical_tolerances.later_period_temperature_rmse_c: diagnostic only; the production acceptance threshold remains less than or equal to 1.0 degC
numerical_tolerances.unexplained_air_node_gain_w: no post-hoc acceptance threshold; sign, distribution, and correlations are diagnostic evidence

known_deviations: This is a post-hoc observation-constrained energy-path audit, not calibration, blind validation, or new acceptance evidence.
Measured air temperature constrains every interval while unmeasured mean radiant and mass temperature is conditionally estimated.
The residual changes sign and has large zone-dependent tails, so it does not support adding one fitted constant conductance.
The production empirical result remains rejected and additional calibration is not authorized by this audit.
